facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/alex.build_alexnet_model: build a PyTorch AlexNet model with optional Sobel filter and batch normalization for image classification
facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/alex.create_feature_layers: create convolutional feature layers from a config tuple list with optional batch norm and ReLU
facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/alex.run_alexnet_forward: run the AlexNet forward pass on input tensor through features, classifier, and top layer
facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/alex.review_initialize_weights: review the AlexNet weight initialization logic for Conv2d, BatchNorm2d, and Linear layers
facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/alex.summarize_alexnet_config: summarize the AlexNet 2012 architecture config with filter counts, kernel sizes, strides, and padding

facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/vgg1.build_vgg16_model: build a VGG16 model with optional Sobel edge detection and batch normalization for image classification
facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/vgg1.create_vgg16_with_sobel: create a VGG16 model with Sobel edge detection filters enabled for edge-aware feature extraction
facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/vgg1.create_make_layers: create a sequential feature extraction layer stack with configurable batch normalization from a channel config
facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/vgg1.review_VGG_forward: review the VGG forward pass that applies Sobel, features, classifier, and top layer sequentially
facebookresearch_deepcluster/models/vgg1.review_VGG_initialize_weights: review the VGG weight initialization using Kaiming normal for Conv2d and normal for Linear layers

facebookresearch_deepcluster/visu/activ-.run_activ_retrieval: run the activ-retrieval script to retrieve images with maximal activations for a given model and dataset
facebookresearch_deepcluster/visu/activ-.run_parse_args: run parse_args to build an argparse parser for activ-retrieval CLI arguments like data, model, conv, exp, count, and workers
facebookresearch_deepcluster/visu/activ-.run_main: run main to load a model, compute layer activations across a dataset, and save top-N images per filter
facebookresearch_deepcluster/visu/activ-.run_forward: run forward to extract per-channel activation scores from a specified ReLU layer in a model's feature modules
facebookresearch_deepcluster/visu/activ-.review_forward: review the forward function to understand how it iterates over model features and extracts channel-wise mean activations
